name: button
title: Button
description: An action button: primary, secondary, ghost and danger variants in three density-aware sizes, with disabled and loading states.
usage: Use one primary Button per view for the main action, secondary next to it, ghost in toolbars and dense rows, danger for destructive actions. Give it a visible text label; for an icon alone use IconButton. Set loading while the action runs instead of disabling it, and type="submit" inside a form.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight. One primary action per view; danger for actions that destroy data.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: loading
props.description: The action is running: focusable, ignores clicks, sets aria-busy and data-loading.

props.name: type
props.description: The native button type. Defaults to button so a Button inside a form does not submit it.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element (a link) with the button's props and behaviour.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The button; data-slot="button", data-variant and data-size name its variant.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the button: the variant's hover colour.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring, offset by ring.offset.

states.name: loading
states.description: Running: aria-busy, ignores clicks, stays focusable.

accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it.
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable (aria-disabled) so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy.
The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only (focus-visible) and meets 3:1 against every surface (token pair color.ring).
Text and background pairs of every variant are contrast-checked by the token build in light and dark.
